what: Roster-wide measurements from a full-roster harvest. Written ONLY by a full-roster run. tests/document-claims.test.ts compares the project documents against these figures; a document that disagrees fails the suite. Every figure states what it counts.

definitions.abilityPages: distinct wiki ability pages after alias dedupe by revision id
definitions.storable: entries with at least one stored damage component
definitions.worklist: entries that stored nothing and that at least one source says deal damage
definitions.noDamage: entries that stored nothing and about which every source is silent
definitions.componentsStored: damage components surviving the summary, non-champion and unreadable-row filters
definitions.confirmedByGate2: storable entries where at least one of the three round-trips compared something and none disagreed. NOT verified, which additionally requires an independent re-derivation
definitions.gate7Failures: storable entries whose additive components do not sum to the whole-ability total the source itself states, at rank 1
